title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function \( \mathcal{L}(\theta) \) is designed to penalize incorrect predictions. It is important to understand how the terms in the loss function contribute to the overall cost.

title: Comparing with Cross-Entropy Loss
text: The standard cross-entropy loss is given by \( -[y\log(p)+(1-y)\log(1-p)] \). Compare this with the given loss function to see how they differ.

title: Analyzing the False Positive Penalty
text: In the given loss function, the term \((1-y)\log((1-p)**3)\) is used instead of \((1-y)\log(1-p)\). This increases the penalty for false positives.
